description.narrative: CRDB Bank Plc is the leading provider for financial services in Tanzania with operations in both Tanzania and Burundi, East Africa. CRDB offers a comprehensive range of corporate, retail, business, treasury, and wholesale microfinance services through a network of 120 branches.It was established in 1996 and was listed on the Dar Es Salaam Stock exchange (DSE) in June 2009. It has a 20 per cent market share in Tanzania.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: We invested in CRDB Bank Plc’s inaugural Sukuk bond to help improve capital market development and strengthen the capacity of domestic financial institutions in Tanzania. By demonstrating this as a viable and replicable funding format, the investment aims to unlock both retail and institutional capital. This kind of capital is currently under-deployed or poorly utilised given the limited number of Sharia-compliant investable opportunities in the country. The funds will be reinvested into the real economy through the growth of CRDB’s Islamic Banking Window, which is driving financial inclusion through the provision of growth capital for corporates and MSMEs previously underserved by the banking market.
